links.outcome: Clinically relevant PubMed identifiers produced by frontier LLMs in citations
links.effect: No model produced a clinically relevant PMID without prompting; when asked to cite, best model achieved 15.3% relevant PMIDs; majority resolved to unrelated publications.
links.quote: No model produced a clinically relevant PubMed identifier without prompting.

links.outcome: Evidence verifiability and clinical coverage of grounded knowledge graph versus ungrounded/RAG baselines
links.effect: HEG-TKG matched baseline clinical feature coverage with 100% evidence verifiability (203 inline citations); Guideline-RAG produced zero verifiable citations; clinician evaluation d = 1.81, p < 0.001, no degradation on safety or completeness.
links.quote: In a controlled three-arm comparison using the same synthesis model, HEG-TKG matches baseline clinical feature coverage while achieving 100% evidence verifiability with 203 inline citations.

links.outcome: Traceability of claims to source via citation trace and detectability of injected errors
links.effect: 80% resistance to injected clinical errors with 100% detectability via citation trace; clinician-rated verifiability advantage d = 1.81.
links.quote: A counterfactual experiment shows 80% resistance to injected clinical errors with 100% detectability via citation trace.
